clips.send: RNA polymerase. The copying enzyme. This enzyme unzips the DNA at a gene and links RNA nucleotides together. It pairs bases by the rules A–U, T–A, G–C, C–G. It is a protein itself, made from its own gene!

clips.send: Nucleus. Keeps the DNA safe. The nucleus holds the DNA, the cell’s complete set of instructions. DNA never leaves the nucleus, so the cell sends out mRNA copies instead. Transcription happens inside the nucleus.
clips.text: Nucleus. Keeps the DNA safe. The nucleus holds the DNA, the cell’s complete set of instructions.. DNA never leaves the nucleus, so the cell sends out mRNA copies instead.. Transcription happens inside the nucleus.

clips.send: Messenger RNA (mRNA). The working copy. mRNA is a single strand that carries the gene’s message from the nucleus to a ribosome. RNA uses the base U (uracil) instead of T, and the sugar ribose instead of deoxyribose. Every 3 bases form a codon. AUG is the START codon; UAA, UAG and UGA are STOP codons.

clips.send: Nuclear pore. Exit door of the nucleus. Nuclear pores are tiny gates in the nuclear envelope. Finished mRNA leaves the nucleus through a pore to reach the ribosomes in the cytoplasm.
clips.text: Nuclear pore. Exit door of the nucleus. Nuclear pores are tiny gates in the nuclear envelope.. Finished mRNA leaves the nucleus through a pore to reach the ribosomes in the cytoplasm.

clips.send: Common mix-up: mRNA is not an identical copy of DNA: it is complementary to the template strand and has U instead of T.
clips.text: Common mix-up: mRNA is not an identical copy of DNA: it is complementary to the template strand and has U instead of T.

clips.send: Ribosome. The protein factory. A ribosome has a small and a large subunit that clamp around the mRNA. It slides along the mRNA one codon (3 bases) at a time. It links amino acids together with peptide bonds.
clips.text: Ribosome. The protein factory. A ribosome has a small and a large subunit that clamp around the mRNA.. It slides along the mRNA one codon (3 bases) at a time.. It links amino acids together with peptide bonds.

clips.send: Transfer RNA (tRNA). The delivery truck. Each tRNA carries one specific amino acid. Its anticodon (3 bases) pairs with a matching codon on the mRNA, like a key in a lock. Example: the codon AUG pairs with the anticodon UAC, which carries methionine.

clips.send: Common mix-up: A gene does not turn directly into a trait; the protein it codes for causes the trait.
clips.text: Common mix-up: A gene does not turn directly into a trait; the protein it codes for causes the trait.

clips.send: DNA and the gene. The master recipe. A gene is a section of DNA that holds the instructions for one protein. Only ONE of the two DNA strands (the template strand) is read to make the mRNA. The highlighted gene here is 18 base pairs long. Real genes are often thousands.
clips.text: DNA & the gene. The master recipe. A gene is a section of DNA that holds the instructions for one protein.. Only ONE of the two DNA strands (the template strand) is read to make the mRNA.. The highlighted gene here is 18 base pairs long. Real genes are often thousands.

clips.send: Protein. The finished, working product. When the ribosome reaches a STOP codon, the chain is released. The chain folds into a 3D shape. Its shape lets it do its job: enzymes, muscle, hair (keratin), hemoglobin…. Proteins build and run your body, and they are how genes produce traits.

clips.send: Amino acids. The building blocks of proteins. There are 20 kinds of amino acids in living things. The ORDER of amino acids decides the shape and job of the protein. Here the chain spells M-A-G-I-C: Met, Ala, Gly, Ile, Cys.

clips.send: 核糖体。蛋白质的“装配工厂”。核糖体由一大一小两个亚基组成，夹住 mRNA。它沿着 mRNA 一次移动一个密码子（3 个碱基）。它用肽键把氨基酸连接起来。
clips.text: 核糖体. 蛋白质的“装配工厂”. 核糖体由一大一小两个亚基组成，夹住 mRNA。. 它沿着 mRNA 一次移动一个密码子（3 个碱基）。. 它用肽键把氨基酸连接起来。

clips.send: 氨基酸。组成蛋白质的“积木”。生物体内有 20 种氨基酸。氨基酸的“排列顺序”决定蛋白质的形状和功能。这里的链拼成 M-A-G-I-C：甲硫氨酸、丙氨酸、甘氨酸、异亮氨酸、半胱氨酸。
clips.text: 氨基酸. 组成蛋白质的“积木”. 生物体内有 20 种氨基酸。. 氨基酸的“排列顺序”决定蛋白质的形状和功能。. 这里的链拼成 M-A-G-I-C：甲硫氨酸、丙氨酸、甘氨酸、异亮氨酸、半胱氨酸。

clips.send: 蛋白质。最终有功能的产物。核糖体读到终止密码子时，肽链被释放。肽链折叠成特定的立体结构，这个结构决定了它的功能：酶、肌肉、头发（角蛋白）、血红蛋白……。蛋白质构建并维持身体的运转，基因正是通过蛋白质来控制性状的。
clips.text: 蛋白质. 最终有功能的产物. 核糖体读到终止密码子时，肽链被释放。. 肽链折叠成特定的立体结构，这个结构决定了它的功能：酶、肌肉、头发（角蛋白）、血红蛋白……. 蛋白质构建并维持身体的运转，基因正是通过蛋白质来控制性状的。

clips.send: DNA 与基因。原始“配方”。基因是 DNA 上指导合成一种蛋白质的一段。DNA 的两条链中只有“一条”（模板链）被用来合成 mRNA。这里发光的基因有 18 个碱基对，真实的基因往往长达几千个碱基对。
clips.text: DNA 与基因. 原始“配方”. 基因是 DNA 上指导合成一种蛋白质的一段。. DNA 的两条链中只有“一条”（模板链）被用来合成 mRNA。. 这里发光的基因有 18 个碱基对，真实的基因往往长达几千个碱基对。

clips.send: 容易混淆：密码子在 mRNA 上，反密码子在 tRNA 上。轮盘查的是 mRNA 密码子，不是 DNA。
clips.text: 容易混淆：密码子在 mRNA 上，反密码子在 tRNA 上。轮盘查的是 mRNA 密码子，不是 DNA。

clips.send: 核孔。细胞核的“出入口”。核孔是核膜上的小通道。合成好的 mRNA 通过核孔离开细胞核，到达细胞质中的核糖体。
clips.text: 核孔. 细胞核的“出入口”. 核孔是核膜上的小通道。. 合成好的 mRNA 通过核孔离开细胞核，到达细胞质中的核糖体。

clips.send: 转运 RNA(tRNA)。运送氨基酸的“小货车”。每种 tRNA 只运载一种特定的氨基酸。它的反密码子（3 个碱基）与 mRNA 上的密码子互补配对，像钥匙对锁。例如：密码子 AUG 与反密码子 UAC 配对，这个 tRNA 运载甲硫氨酸。
clips.text: 转运 RNA(tRNA). 运送氨基酸的“小货车”. 每种 tRNA 只运载一种特定的氨基酸。. 它的反密码子（3 个碱基）与 mRNA 上的密码子互补配对，像钥匙对锁。. 例如：密码子 AUG 与反密码子 UAC 配对，这个 tRNA 运载甲硫氨酸。

clips.send: 容易混淆：基因并不直接变成性状，而是通过它编码的蛋白质表现出性状。

clips.send: 容易混淆：mRNA 不是 DNA 的“完全相同”的复制品：它与模板链互补，而且用 U 代替 T。

clips.send: 细胞核。保护 DNA 的“控制中心”。细胞核里储存着 DNA，也就是细胞的全部“说明书”。DNA 不离开细胞核，细胞改为送出 mRNA 副本。转录在细胞核内进行。
clips.text: 细胞核. 保护 DNA 的“控制中心”. 细胞核里储存着 DNA，也就是细胞的全部“说明书”。. DNA 不离开细胞核，细胞改为送出 mRNA 副本。. 转录在细胞核内进行。

clips.send: 信使 RNA(mRNA)。基因的“工作副本”。mRNA 是单链，把基因的信息从细胞核带到核糖体。RNA 用碱基 U（尿嘧啶）代替 T，用核糖代替脱氧核糖。每 3 个碱基组成一个密码子。AUG 是起始密码子；UAA、UAG、UGA 是终止密码子。

clips.send: RNA 聚合酶。负责“抄写”的酶。这种酶在基因处解开 DNA，并把 RNA 核苷酸连接起来。它按照 A–U、T–A、G–C、C–G 的规则配对碱基。它本身也是一种蛋白质，由自己的基因编码！
